title: Hackers activate automatic defrosting in supermarket fridges across Europe
why_read: An interesting real-world story about IoT security failures in commercial refrigeration systems, though it reads more like a security incident report than deep technical analysis.
analysis: The story describes hackers remotely triggering defrost cycles on supermarket refrigeration units across Europe, apparently by exploiting internet-connected industrial control systems. This matters because it highlights how exposed and poorly secured operational technology and IoT devices are in critical infrastructure like food supply chains. It's a good real-world case study in IoT security negligence even without deep technical detail in the title alone.
